Learnathon is a celebration of learning, of our free content here at SciShow and all of Complexly! We’re doing activities and videos and livestream Nov 3-21 at complexly.org/LEARNATHON

Depending on where you live, Yellowstone might be the most famous (or infamous) supervolcano. But there are plenty other of supervolcanoes around the world, from Japan, to New Zealand, to Guatemala and more!

Hosted by: Denali Kincaid (they/them)
